text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит wins the Japanese
Derby, and
Biwa Hayahide is terrified by
how easily her friend
renders her
calculations meaningless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her numerous calculations,
Winning
Ticket and Нарита Таисин both
have something
that keeps defying her
estimations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If so, then we just have to factor that
"something"
into the equation. Doing so
without knowing what
we're dealing with
is reckless, but Бива Хаяхидэ
comes up
with a hypothesis.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She realizes she lacks the iron will to
improve and
asks me to increase her
training intensity to avoid
defeat at the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
